**Date:** 14 March 2031, when the record run took place at the Corrowen Test Loop.

**Person:** Dr. Isela Marwick, Chief Test Engineer at Vantry Transit Systems, who supervised the run and confirmed the reading.

**Figure:** The prototype reached 380 km/h on a 14.2 km stretch of straight guideway, holding that speed for about 11 seconds.

**Source document:** Vantry Transit Systems Test Report VT-P2-117, certified by the Halvern Rail Standards Board.
